BETA Close X RS Group PLC has purchased 3,340,715 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between July 20 and July 24, 2026, with prices ranging from 660.0000 pence to 690.0000 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 470,708,753, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 470,708,753 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 27 July 2026 RS Group plc 27 July 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 20 July 2026 to 24 July 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
